description: This file contains implementation of multiple Orleans grains related to request context testing, including request ID tracing and logging functionality.

classes.name: RequestContextTestGrain
classes.description: Grain implementing IRequestContextTestGrain to test request context echo functions.

classes.name: RequestContextTaskGrain
classes.description: Grain implementing IRequestContextTaskGrain with detailed logging and various async patterns to test request context propagation.

classes.name: RequestContextProxyGrain
classes.description: Grain implementing IRequestContextProxyGrain, providing E2EActivityId via delegation.

methods.name: TraceIdEcho
methods.description: Returns the current TraceId from RequestContext.

methods.name: TraceIdDoubleEcho
methods.description: Obtains another grain and calls its TraceIdEcho to test context propagation.

methods.name: TraceIdDelayedEcho1
methods.description: Returns TraceId using Task.Factory.StartNew to test context flow.

methods.name: TraceIdDelayedEcho2
methods.description: Returns TraceId via ContinueWith, testing context in continuations.

methods.name: TraceIdDelayedEchoAwait
methods.description: Await-based method to test context flow with async/await.

methods.name: TraceIdDelayedEchoTaskRun
methods.description: Returns TraceId via Task.Run, checking context propagation inside task.

methods.name: E2EActivityId
methods.description: Returns the current ReentrancyId associated with the request.

methods.name: TestRequestContext
methods.description: Sets and reads request context data inside multiple tasks to validate context propagation.
